corinthians2.5.p1.b1.text: Now we know that if the earthly tent we live in is dismantled,

corinthians2.5.p1.b2.text: we have a building from God, an eternal house in heaven, not built by human hands.

corinthians2.5.p1.b3.text: … so that our mortality may be swallowed up by life.

corinthians2.5.p2.b2.text: For we walk by faith, not by sight.

corinthians2.5.p2.b3.text: So we aspire to please Him,

corinthians2.5.p3.b1.text: If we are out of our mind, it is for God; if we are of sound mind, it is for you.

corinthians2.5.p3.b3.text: … that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but for Him who died for them and was raised again.

corinthians2.5.p4.b1.text: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh.

corinthians2.5.p4.b2.text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!

corinthians2.5.p5.b1.text: All this is from God, who reconciled us to Himself through Christ

corinthians2.5.p5.b2.text: that God was reconciling the world to Himself in Christ, not counting men’s trespasses against them.

corinthians2.5.p5.b3.text: And He has committed to us the message of reconciliation.

corinthians2.5.p6.b1.text: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us.

corinthians2.5.p6.b2.text: We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.

corinthians2.5.p6.b3.text: God made Him who knew no sin to be sin on our behalf, so that in Him we might become the righteousness of God.
